description: INIT { STRATEGY WARM } from a bootstrapped seed_pot.tadah.

evaluations.note: 30 on the reference machine (2026-10-07, 3 repeated runs identical; 8 before each finite-difference gradient took the loss at its point as its centre, when BFGS ended after its second gradient). The WARM start is on the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 1, the best), BFGS takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 2-3), and from eval 4 its line search re-evaluates the clamped bound until MAXEVAL = 30, as in example 05 (a scratch build of the same code with other compiler flags ended after the second gradient, at 6). Whether it accepts a re-evaluation of the bound depends on rounding-level noise (see example 01), so the count is not pinned (evals_tol 30); best loss, components and RCUT2B do not depend on it.

tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances. The WARM start is on the clamped bound RCUT2B = 6.0, and whether DLIB:BFGS's line search accepts a re-evaluation there depends on rounding-level noise, as in example 01 (evaluations.note), so evals_tol 30 accepts both of its endings: MAXEVAL = 30, "DLIB:BFGS: MAXEVAL reached" (the reference machine, 2026-10-07), and the objective-delta test after the second gradient, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" (a scratch build with other compiler flags, 6 evaluations; FTOL_ABS is 1e-7 by default). Both ended COMPLETED until every HPO driver recorded why it ended, 2026-10-07.
